commercial.case_study_claim: Built an evolutionary routing solver that reached #1 on the public OPTIL.io CVRPTW benchmark against a real incumbent field.
commercial.offer: Build or tune a vehicle-routing optimizer with capacity and time-window constraints, with reproducible cost, route-quality, and service-level metrics.

domain: logistics vehicle routing with time windows

canary.promotion_rule: Promote only if the first legal generic solver submission is valid and reaches at least 97.5, then require an improving survivor before full search.

donors.contribution: hybrid genetic search, time windows, capacity constraints
OR-Tools routing/time-window modeling and search strategies

evolution.weakness_hypothesis: The public field has only 20 users and the leader is 99.87 rather than 100.00; current open-source VRPTW solvers expose hybrid genetic and adaptive local-search machinery that can be ensembled and tuned against a small official-shaped canary before spending the week.

execution.carrier: C++/Python routing solver submitted to OPTIL judge

notes: Live browser readback: b804 99.87, swats 99.27, HiryBudaj 98.92. Submit enabled with 20-minute cooldown. Precise claim: #1 on OPTIL.io CVRPTW.

prestige.institution_or_platform: OPTIL.io / Poznan University of Technology optimization judge

probability.basis: Live standing shows only 20 users but a very strong 99.87 incumbent; PyVRP and OR-Tools supply excellent donors and the commercial translation is unusually legible, yet the remaining 0.13-point gap may be hard and local reproduction is not yet proven.

target.track: Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
